Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting from use tax certain purchases from nonprofit organizations or libraries sold as a fundraising activity.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting from use tax certain purchases fromnonprofit organizations or libraries sold as a fundraising activity;adding a new section to chapter 82.12 RCW; and providing an effectivedate.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provisions of this chapter do not apply in respect to the useof any article of personal property, valued at less than ten thousanddollars, purchased or received as a prize in a contest of chance, asdefined in RCW 82.04.285, from a nonprofit organization or a library,if the gross income the nonprofit organization or library receives fromthe sale is exempt under RCW 82.04.3651.
